env GO111MODULE=off
# Temporary: enable -splitdwarf explicitly until it is on by default.
[GOOS:darwin] env GOFLAGS=-ldflags=-splitdwarf

# 'go install' with no arguments should clean up after go build
cd mycmd
go build
exists mycmd$GOEXE
[GOOS:darwin] exists mycmd$GOEXE.dSYM
go install
! exists mycmd$GOEXE
! exists mycmd$GOEXE.dSYM

# 'go install mycmd' does not clean up, even in the mycmd directory
go build
exists mycmd$GOEXE
[GOOS:darwin] exists mycmd$GOEXE.dSYM
go install mycmd
exists mycmd$GOEXE
[GOOS:darwin] exists mycmd$GOEXE.dSYM

# 'go install mycmd' should not clean up in an unrelated current directory either
cd ..
cp mycmd/mycmd$GOEXE mycmd$GOEXE
go install mycmd
exists mycmd$GOEXE

-- mycmd/main.go --
package main
func main() {}
